unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Antimicrobial potency values remain absent; clinical efficacy/safety rows are source-supported and preserved instead of fabricating MIC-like rows.

cautions: Clinical rows are not antimicrobial MIC/MBC potency rows.
No local supplement changed activity/toxicity interpretation beyond the primary clinical outcomes.
